description: This file defines a PHP class Location within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing localisation locations including listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting location data. It interacts with models, views, and other controllers to facilitate CRUD operations for location entities in the admin interface.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation location entities within the Opencart admin interface, handling CRUD operations, rendering views, and interacting with models for data persistence.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the location list page, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and loads the main location view with necessary data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to retrieve and output the list of locations.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of locations from the model, constructs data for the view including pagination, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for the location add/edit form, loads existing location data if editing, and renders the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to add or update a location, performs validation, and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected locations if the user has permission and returns a JSON response with the outcome.
